§ 10.4 Exclusions.
§ 10.4 Exclusions.
(a) 
Grants.
et seq.
(b) 
Contracts and agreements with and grants to Indian Tribes.
et seq.
(c) 
Procurement contracts for construction that are excluded from coverage of the Davis-Bacon Act.
(d) 
Contracts for services that are exempted from coverage under the Service Contract Act.
(e) 
Employees who are exempt from the minimum wage requirements of the Fair Labor Standards Act under 29 U.S.C. 213(a) and 214(a)-(b).
(1) 
Learners, apprentices, or messengers.
(2) 
Students.
(3) 
Individuals employed in a bona fide executive, administrative, or professional capacity.
(f) 
FLSA-covered workers performing in connection with covered contracts for less than 20 percent of their work hours in a given workweek.
